description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Safehold Elite.
When Safehold Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Safehold Elite.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
